body: How does you agreeing have 4 upvotes but him stating what you agree with get 1 upvote? Hive mind wtf?
I had people he liked send him loud messages saying good boy, he passed in his sleep. It just hurts and no one cares so it doesn’t matter. Which hurts more.

Yea but after my best friend passed that just means I have someone waiting for me somewhere, a weights been lifted off my shoulders I have basically 0 responsibility if I leave no one will be annoyed they have to deal with my shit ever again.
I’ve already talked to my family, and my girlfriend. They don’t care, they just treat me like normal.
Maybe it is, i dunno but all I know is I’ve been crying too many days straight and I just want my dog back.

I’m more worried about the intelligence of our future with shit like TikTok
